headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 22, 2026**
article:
The Guardians secured a 3-1 victory over the Tigers, with Joey Cantillo earning the win after 5.2 innings of scoreless relief. Dillon Dingler led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other games, the Pirates took down the Cardinals 6-2 behind Braxton Ashcraft's strong outing, while the Mets edged out the Nationals 2-1. The Braves blasted past the Marlins 9-3, with Michael Harris II hitting two home runs and driving in three runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Ke'Bryan Hayes (Cincinnati Reds) who was placed on the 10-day injured list with a lumbar bulging disc. The Los Angeles Angels also placed Yoán Moncada on the 10-day injured list due to right knee inflammation, and Yusei Kikuchi was transferred to the 60-day injured list with left shoulder inflammation. Other notable injuries include Matt Shaw (Chicago Cubs) with mid-back tightness, Nathan Church (St. Louis Cardinals) with a left shoulder strain, and Brenton Doyle (Colorado Rockies) with a left oblique contusion.

The Reds made a notable trade, acquiring RHP Zach McCambley from the Marlins in exchange for RF Rece Hinds. The Rays also traded LHP Joe Rock to the White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn, while the Dodgers acquired LHP Eric Lauer from the Blue Jays for cash. The White Sox traded CF Junior Perez to the Athletics for LHP Jackson Nove.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Tigers 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Joey Cantillo earning the win after 5.2 innings of scoreless relief. Dillon Dingler led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Cardinals 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Braxton Ashcraft leading the way on the mound. Ashcraft pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Nationals in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets edged out the Washington Nationals with a final score of 2-1, securing their win. David Peterson earned the win for the Mets, while Devin Williams secured the save.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Past Marlins 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a convincing 9-3 victory over the Miami Marlins, with Michael Harris II leading the charge at the plate. Harris II hit two home runs, including his 11th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Cubs 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 victory over the Chicago Cubs, marking a win for the Astros. Christian Vázquez and Pete Crow-Armstrong were notable contributors in the game.

top_news.title: **Reds Shut Down Cardinals in Scoreless Tie**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 0-0 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Zach McCambley pitching for the Reds.

top_news.title: **Reds Place Ke'Bryan Hayes on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Ke'Bryan Hayes, the third baseman for the Cincinnati Reds, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a lumbar bulging disc. The move is retroactive to May 21, 2026.

top_news.title: **Reds Make Roster Move Ahead of Weekend Series**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds have made a trade, acquiring RHP Zach McCambley from the Miami Marlins in exchange for RF Rece Hinds.
